en.text: Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.

zhSimplified.text: 凡敬畏耶和华、 遵行他道的人便为有福！

zhTraditional.text: 凡敬畏耶和華、 遵行他道的人便為有福！

en.text: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

zhSimplified.text: 你要吃劳碌得来的； 你要享福，事情顺利。

zhTraditional.text: 你要吃勞碌得來的； 你要享福，事情順利。

en.text: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

zhSimplified.text: 你妻子在你的内室，好像多结果子的葡萄树； 你儿女围绕你的桌子，好像橄榄栽子。

zhTraditional.text: 你妻子在你的內室，好像多結果子的葡萄樹； 你兒女圍繞你的桌子，好像橄欖栽子。

en.text: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，敬畏耶和华的人必要这样蒙福！

zhTraditional.text: 看哪，敬畏耶和華的人必要這樣蒙福！

en.text: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

zhSimplified.text: 愿耶和华从锡安赐福给你！ 愿你一生一世看见耶路撒冷的好处！

zhTraditional.text: 願耶和華從錫安賜福給你！ 願你一生一世看見耶路撒冷的好處！

en.text: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 愿你看见你儿女的儿女！ 愿平安归于以色列！

zhTraditional.text: 願你看見你兒女的兒女！ 願平安歸於以色列！
